messages:
emily_sales: MerchantX asks for a 2-week POC: streaming SDK + function-calls to return structured rowsets, plus SSO and reserved pricing questions.

raj_se: Which SDKs?

emily_sales: Python backend + Node frontend.

camila_eng: We can provide a tiny repo: python stream example + mock tool that returns rows as JSON objects. Will include schema example and validation hook.

raj_se: Quick snippet to share:
```py
for c in client.stream('run'):
  handle(c)
res = client.call_tool('sql_exec', {'q': 'SELECT id,name FROM orders'})
rows = res['rows']
```

tom_prod: Note to mention struct_output schema and schema_validation events for missing fields.

nina_sec: Security asks: SSO/SAML, SOC2, KMS customer-managed keys, and 30d retention. Hosted ok to start?

camila_eng: Hosted + enterprise add-on supports account-level IP allowlist; Dedicated gives VPC and KMS.

kai_support: Common POC blockers: websocket TTL (60s), short-lived creds refresh, and schema mismatch. I'll add a short runbook.

emily_sales: Pricing: they estimate ~20-30M tokens/mo. Can finance give a reserved ballpark?

tom_prod: Ballpark: reserved typically lowers unit cost ~30-45% depending on commit; we'll get formal numbers from pricing. Suggest starting hosted then switch to reserved if sustained.

emily_sales: I'll loop MerchantX contact (maria@merchantx.co) and request the security questionnaire. Camila/Kai please drop the demo repo & runbook.

deploy-bot: Repo "merchantx-poc" branch created by camila_eng at 1725007799.
